description: What needs you. view='new' reports what changed since your last dismiss (conversations and threads, watermark-tracked). view='unreads' scans unread DMs and channels. view='mentions' collects your @-mentions by urgency. Read-only; nothing here marks anything read.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous page (mentions)

limit.description: Maximum items (new: default 50; unreads: per category, max 25; mentions: per page, max 50)

scope.description: new only: watermark scope for multiple independent watchers

timeframe.description: mentions only: how far back to look (default 3d)

name: inbox
